subject: Project Palisade kickoff: fact tracing for LM assertions
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off our fact-tracing effort. Internally we're calling this Project Palisade — please use the codename in subject lines and docs so search stays clean.

The basis is our open-source fact-tracing work: given a factual assertion an LM generates, identify which training examples taught it that — the "proponents". The release's benchmark compares gradient-based and embedding-based training-data-attribution methods, and notably both trail a BM25 baseline that never touches the model. Product framing: provenance for model assertions, which legal and enterprise customers keep asking for.

Milestones:
- Mar 6: benchmark reproduced end to end.
- Apr 10: TDA methods + BM25 baseline evaluated on a slice of our own pretraining corpus.
- May 8: readout with a go/no-go on productizing provenance.

Alina owns staffing; Linnea is tech lead.

Anders
